ns2:course.label: Controlling Turfgrass Pests
ns2:course.description: Principles and strategies of integrated pest management (IPM), turf management practices, and common pests of turf are examined. The biology, habitat, identifying features, and management strategies of each pest are described. Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: HORT 236 and CPSC 270 or NRES 280; and PLPA 204.
